تلتبسين (form VIII)
# تَلْتَبِسِينَ (taltabisīna) /tal.ta.bi.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# تُلْتَبَسِينَ (tultabasīna) /tul.ta.ba.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
